  Fun: 9.00
  Transport: 1000.00

I fixed `week_key` in `dates.py` so weeks start on Sunday. The existing tests pass (0 failed), but none of them cover `week_key`. I checked a few dates by hand instead.

`week_key` used ISO weeks, which start on Monday. That put Sunday at the end of one week and Saturday in the same week as the following Monday. Sunday now shifts forward one day before the ISO lookup, so it joins the Monday–Saturday that follows it.

| 2026-01-04 | Sunday | `2026-W02` |
| 2026-01-05 | Monday | `2026-W02` |
| 2026-01-10 | Saturday | `2026-W02` |
| 2026-01-11 | Sunday | `2026-W03` |

Saturday 2026-01-10 stays with the week that began Sunday 2026-01-04, and the key format is unchanged. I changed only `week_key` and added no tests or docs.
